rules.description: PO Review Stories with all subtasks Done → BA Analysis
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND {stage.PO_REVIEW:PO Review}

rules.description: BA Analysis Stories → generate Acceptance Criteria
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND status in ('{status.BA_ANALYSIS:BA Analysis}')

rules.description: Solution Architecture Stories → generate Solution Design
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND status in ('{status.SOLUTION_ARCHITECTURE:Solution Architecture}')

rules.description: Subtasks with 'q' label → trigger PO refinement
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Subtask') AND labels in ('q') and status not in ({status.DONE:Done})

rules.description: Backlog / To Do Stories → ask clarification questions
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND status in ('{status.BACKLOG:Backlog}', '{status.TODO:To Do}')

rules.description: Backlog / To Do Tasks (children of parent ticket) → run intake agent
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Task') AND status in ('{status.BACKLOG:Backlog}', '{status.TODO:To Do}') AND parent = {parentTicket}

rules.description: Ready For Development Stories → trigger story_development
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND status in ('{status.READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT:Ready For Development}')

rules.description: Provider-quota parked tickets → probe the quota window (gh-1087)
rules.jql: labels = provider_quota

rules.description: Failed Test Cases with linked Bugs → recover Bug To Fix
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND {stage.FAILED:Failed} ORDER BY updated ASC

rules.description: Failed Test Cases → create or link bugs in batch
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND {stage.FAILED:Failed} AND (labels is EMPTY OR labels NOT IN ('sm_bug_creation_triggered')) ORDER BY created ASC

rules.description: Backlog / To Do / Ready For Development / In Development / In Rework Bugs → trigger bug_development
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Bug') AND status in ('{status.BACKLOG:Backlog}', '{status.TODO:To Do}', '{status.READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT:Ready For Development}', '{status.IN_DEVELOPMENT:In Development}', '{status.IN_PROGRESS:In Progress}', '{status.IN_REWORK:In Rework}') AND updated <= -15m ORDER BY updated ASC

rules.description: Review/Rework/Blocked Stories & Bugs with already merged PR → recover Merged status
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story', 'Bug') AND status in ('{status.IN_REVIEW:In Review}', '{status.IN_REWORK:In Rework}', '{status.BLOCKED:Blocked}') ORDER BY updated ASC

rules.description: Blocked Stories & Bugs with all resolved dependencies → move to Backlog
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story', 'Bug') AND status in ('{status.BLOCKED:Blocked}') ORDER BY updated ASC

rules.description: In Review Stories & Bugs → trigger pr_review
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story', 'Bug') AND status in ('{status.IN_REVIEW:In Review}') AND (labels is EMPTY OR labels NOT IN ('pr_approved'))

rules.description: In Review Stories & Bugs (pr_approved) → retry merge
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story', 'Bug') AND status in ('{status.IN_REVIEW:In Review}') AND labels = 'pr_approved' ORDER BY created ASC

rules.description: In Rework Stories & Bugs → trigger pr_rework
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story', 'Bug') AND status in ('{status.IN_REWORK:In Rework}')

rules.description: In Review Test Cases (pr_approved) → retry merge
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND ({stage.IN_REVIEW_PASSED:In Review - Passed} OR {stage.IN_REVIEW_FAILED:In Review - Failed}) AND labels = 'pr_approved' ORDER BY created ASC

rules.description: In Testing Stories (pr_approved) → merge test automation PR
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND {stage.IN_TESTING:In Testing} AND labels = 'pr_approved' ORDER BY created ASC

rules.description: In Testing Bugs (pr_approved) → merge test automation PR
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Bug') AND {stage.IN_TESTING:In Testing} AND labels = 'pr_approved' ORDER BY created ASC

rules.description: Merged Stories → Ready For Testing + generate test cases
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND {stage.MERGED:Merged}

rules.description: Merged Bugs → Ready For Testing
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Bug') AND {stage.MERGED:Merged}

rules.description: Ready For Testing Bugs → generate test cases
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Bug') AND {stage.READY_FOR_TESTING:Ready For Testing} AND (labels is EMPTY OR labels NOT IN ('sm_bug_test_cases_triggered'))

rules.description: Ready For Testing Bugs → automate linked test cases in bulk
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Bug') AND {stage.READY_FOR_TESTING:Ready For Testing}

rules.description: Ready For Testing Stories → automate linked test cases in bulk
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND {stage.READY_FOR_TESTING:Ready For Testing}

rules.description: In Testing Stories → check all TCs passed → Done
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Story') AND {stage.IN_TESTING:In Testing}

rules.description: In Testing Bugs → check all TCs passed → Done
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Bug') AND {stage.IN_TESTING:In Testing}

rules.description: Intake/In Development Tasks → all linked Stories/Bugs Done → Ready For Testing
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Task') AND status in ('{status.IN_DEVELOPMENT:In Development}', '{status.IN_PROGRESS:In Progress}') AND (parent = {parentTicket} OR labels in ('ai_intake'))

rules.description: Stuck In Development Test Cases → recover (check PR, route to Rework/Review/Backlog)
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND status in ('{status.IN_DEVELOPMENT:In Development}') AND updated <= -15m

rules.description: In Rework Test Cases → trigger pr_test_automation_rework
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND status in ('{status.IN_REWORK:In Rework}')

rules.description: In Review Test Cases → trigger pr_test_automation_review
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND ({stage.IN_REVIEW_PASSED:In Review - Passed} OR {stage.IN_REVIEW_FAILED:In Review - Failed}) AND (labels is EMPTY OR labels NOT IN ('pr_approved'))

rules.description: In Review Test Cases with dirty PR → move to In Rework
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND ({stage.IN_REVIEW_PASSED:In Review - Passed} OR {stage.IN_REVIEW_FAILED:In Review - Failed})

rules.description: Failed Test Cases → create or link bug (single, disabled by default — use bulk_bugs_creation instead)
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND {stage.FAILED:Failed}

rules.description: Backlog / To Do / Ready For Development Test Cases → In Development + automate
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case') AND status in ('{status.BACKLOG:Backlog}', '{status.TODO:To Do}', '{status.READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT:Ready For Development}')

rules.description: Bug To Fix Tickets → all linked Bugs Done → move to Backlog / Ready For Testing
rules.jql: project = {jiraProject} AND issuetype in ('Test Case', 'Story') AND {stage.BUG_TO_FIX:Bug To Fix}
